overview_markdown:
CoPaw (also branded QwenPaw) is a personal AI assistant from the AgentScope team, designed to be easy to install and deploy either on your own machine or in the cloud. It supports multiple chat applications out of the box and exposes an extensible capability model via plugins, skills, and a hub gateway, distributed via PyPI with a documented console UI.

Architecturally it pairs a Python agent runtime (Python 3.11–3.13) with a TypeScript console frontend, and recent commits show heavy investment in frontend performance (lazy-loaded locales, split chat dependencies), memory/reranker configuration UI (ReMe), and stability fixes across CI, Windows support, and tool-call lifecycle handling. Ecosystem digests place it among the small set of high-velocity 'platform' projects alongside OpenClaw, processing dozens of PRs per day.

Compared to OpenClaw, CoPaw differentiates through its AgentScope/Qwen ecosystem integration, polished onboarding, and hub-gateway direction, but it remains in beta versioning with security and sandboxing hardening still catching up. It is a credible OpenClaw alternative for users who value ease of setup and multi-channel chat support over maximum isolation guarantees.
